notes:
Access: HTTP tier 1 only via the site's own Magento GraphQL endpoint (https://www.swooneditions.com/graphql). Enumerated the full 1120-node category tree (3 pages) and keyword-scanned for clearance/outlet/final-sale/end-of-line/refurbished/discontinued terms. Found the genuine Clearance section, id 643, url_path 'clearance'. Fetched its description/meta via categoryList: meta_title 'Furniture On Sale | Refurbished Furniture | Swoon', meta_description "Shop refurbished furniture for a great deal... when these designs are gone, they're gone!", and on-page copy names 'The Refurbished Collection' with 'Almost Perfect' / 'Not Perfect' sub-lines (surface-imperfection stock, permanent limited-run markdown) - this is the site's own taxonomy explicitly framing the page as permanent outlet/refurbished/end-of-line stock (not a temporary promo), so it and its real nav children qualify as Clearance. Children_count=8, all 8 found and matched by url_path prefix 'clearance/': Storage, Tables & Desks, Chairs, Sofas (itself a group with 4 further children: Corner/Four Seater/Two Seater/Three Seater Sofas), Footstools, Beds (site label 'Beds', url 'clearance/sleeping'), Lighting (product_count 0, dropped per zero-qty rule), Accessories. Every row's category.product_count and the live products(filter:{category_id}).total_count matched exactly (checked via a batched GraphQL query across all candidate ids), consistent with the prior Home-Decor pass's finding that this store's Magento totals are not inflated (exhaustion-verified there for 16 categories). Sofas children sum to 356 vs the Sofas parent's 369 - a small (13-unit) overlap between the 4 seat-count sub-cuts, not an error. ALSO CHECKED, FLAGGED, NOT COUNTED AS CLEARANCE: 'Flash SALE' (id 171, url 'flash-sale', product_count 799) - this is a SEPARATE top-level nav node from Clearance. Its on-page copy is temporary flash-sale framing ('Getting half off... A deal this good doesn't linger, and neither will the stock' - scarcity/urgency language typical of a time-boxed promo, not a permanent outlet), but its own meta_title is literally 'Summer Outlet | Swoon', which uses the target word 'Outlet'. Given that direct conflict between the page's own promotional copy (temporary) and its SEO title (permanent-outlet wording), I recorded it as a flagged row below rather than silently including or excluding it. Its own children (13 sub-nodes: 50% off, Bestseller edit, Sofas, Footstools, Storage, Tables, Accessories, Chairs, Sleeping, Living Room, Bedroom, Dining Room, Under £300 edit) were not separately extracted since the parent's Clearance-vs-Sale status itself is unresolved.

[POLICY UPDATE 2026-09-11 PASS 2] Removed 1 Outlet-branded row(s) identified via page title/H1/subdomain evidence (not caught by sub_category name-pattern alone): Outlet is not Clearance.
